इ The third letter of the
Devanāgarī alphabet.

इ {vI.v} {c2c} P. (In Dhātup. written as
इण्) (एति, इयाय, अगात्, एतुं, इत)
1
To go, go to or towards, come to
or near; शशिनं पुनरेति शर्वरी

.
--2 To arrive at, reach, obtain,
attain to, go to or be reduced to a
particular state, fall into;
निर्बुद्धिः क्षयमेति

goes to ruin,
is ruined; so वशं, शत्रुत्वं, शूद्रतां &c.
--3 To return.
--4 To go away, retire;
[]
elapse, pass.
--5 To spring from,
come or arise from.
--6 To undertake
anything (with acc.); सत्रमायन् Vāj.
--7 To ask, beg.
--8 To be; to appear.
--9 To be employed in, go on with,
be in a particular condition or
relation, with a part. or instr.; कृषंतो
ह स्म वैवपंतो यंति Śat. Br.; गवामयनेनेयुः
Kāty.
--10 To thrive, prosper. {vII.v}
{c1c} U. = अय् q. v. {vIII.v} {c4c}

To come,
appear.
--2 To run, wander.
--3 To go
quickly or repeatedly.
--4 To ask,
request. --Caus. To cause to go or
come. [cf. L. eo; Gr. eimi with एमि].

1 To go.
--2 To shine.
--3 To pervade.
--4
To desire, wish.
--5 To throw.
--6 To
eat.
--7 To beg (A.).
--8 To become
pregnant.
